question: Can semantic support and geometric extent be separated so that reference-SAM purity and full bound-door localization both hold on all three multi-door pairs?

predecessor.single_change: Keep the native reference SAM2 mask as the cycle-support and bilateral-scoring domain, but project the original already-bound reference bbox corners through the same frozen affine fit to preserve full object extent. All models, thresholds, components, query SAM postprocess, frames, targets and gates remain unchanged.

source.target_scope: DR01 and DR02 are different physical doors in one reference/rescan family; DR03 is a second family. Every selected scan contains 11-17 provider-labelled doors.

reference_binding.support_surface: One native SAM2 mask prompted by the evaluator-projected reference bbox; used only to choose cycle-consistent correspondences and for bilateral support scoring.
reference_binding.extent_surface: The original already-bound reference bbox rectangle; used only as four corners projected through the support-surface affine map.
reference_binding.purpose: Separate referent appearance support from its complete geometric envelope without exposing query truth. This remains privileged initial binding.

proposal.transport: Unchanged symmetric full-frame RoMa and support selection: certainty >=0.05 in both directions, in-bounds target, round-trip error <=0.013888888888888888, largest 8-connected component, ordinary least-squares affine map. The only change is projecting the already-bound bbox extent corners instead of the SAM support-mask envelope corners.
proposal.component_tie_break: Unchanged maximum component pixel area, then lowest connected-component label; no minimum area, truth access or fallback.
proposal.mask: One native reference SAM2 mask and one native query SAM2 mask, multimask_output=false, mask_threshold=0.0, no score selection, morphology, expansion or retry.

matcher.absolute_support: Unchanged bilateral one-percent native-mask cycle fraction and majority cycle purity.

evaluation.query_target_bbox: Provider query bbox opens only after prompt generation and is used only for IoU scoring.
evaluation.no_cross_pair_assignment_claim: Target-conditioned true-pair component evaluation only; no closed-roster NONE assignment claim.

forbidden_after_freeze: change either support or extent surface, RoMa model or thresholds, connected component, affine fit, SAM2 postprocess, frames, targets or decision gate
use query truth, labels, scan transform, target identity or target-side geometry to generate or select a prompt
expand, shrink, retry, replace or choose another support mask, extent, prompt, component or query mask after target IoU
lower the frozen 0.5 purity or 0.5 IoU gates

call consumed Development initial discovery, open-world absence authority, fresh/provider-independent confirmation, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, arrival, handoff, Android, benefit, reliability or safety evidence
claim_boundary: A pass is consumed posthoc Development evidence that separating a native reference appearance-support mask from its already-bound geometric extent enables target-conditioned localization and bilateral correspondence support across three provider-distinct multi-door pairs without category text or query truth. Both initial surfaces remain privileged, query frames and truth are consumed, only three targets and two scan families are tested, and desktop GPU models are used. It is not initial raw-camera discovery, open-world absence authority, fresh/provider-independent confirmation, named entrance, ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, Android deployment, user benefit, reliability or safety.
